stageA.sourceMathematics: A shape is identified using its sides and corners, not its color, size or rotation. A closed straight-sided polygon has the same count of sides and vertices.
stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Original Activity1 asks pupils to SORT actual illustrated shape cards using a defensible attribute; Activity2 student chooses one authentic shape card and describes it to a partner. Several sorting categories may be valid.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Teacher checks original card shapes, student grouping and oral attributes. No invented source polygon-image labels.
